paper_title_basis: Testing Low-Rank Causal Control in AdamW Memory
paper_title_status: recovered registration draft; submitted portal wording not independently checked
question: Was the Stage07 small-subspace result limited by estimation/truncation, and does functional control concentrate on real-data checkpoints?
completed_parent: 30 Stage07 confirmation tasks; rank16 independent capture mean .3841, h16 remainder ratio mean .8416, H7_F true; H7_L/H7_A/H7_C/H7_M false
design: 8 fixed independently trained models: seeds10100..10103 each on MNIST MLP and CIFAR10 ConvGN; no pilot selection or seed deletion
operator: centered logits after the same first AdamW update, derivative with respect to previous exp_avg at fixed weights, exp_avg_sq, clock and input gradient; parameter-space Euclidean metric
spectrum: explicit FP32-autodiff rows; double-precision Gram algebra. Exact refers to unsketched finite-anchor Jacobian, not infinite precision or global rank
anchors: 64 class-balanced held-out calibration images for fitting;64 disjoint calibration images for energy transfer; disjoint first gradient batch256. Independent test-response128 and remaining test evaluation
methods: exact right subspace versus 24-output-probe, one-power-iteration estimator; separate held-out self-spectrum oracle only a diagnostic, never used for fitting interventions
history: recipient exp_avg minus donor at70percent of reference training, normalized once; donor lag is not selected using responses
interventions: common scale .002*norm(recipient m); full history, its fixed-rank16/rank64 projections, unnormalized orthogonal remainders, each sign, and unchanged baseline: 11 futures/model
future: 64 actual AdamW updates; common first calibration batch and deterministic shared later training/augmentation stream; horizons0,1,4,16,64; per-sign baseline effects and paired contrasts all reported
competency_and_instrument: MNIST accuracy .85/CIFAR .40 quality diagnostics; finite difference error .10 diagnostic. Every seed retained; failed quality/instrument measurements limit interpretation, not sample selection
statistics: four training seeds per dataset; descriptive seed-bootstrap intervals, not formal confirmation or independent image/coordinate replications. No selected best rank or retrospective alpha thresholds
controls: 8 tensor-norm-matched random directions, sign-shuffled history, within-tensor permutation, gradient, preconditioned gradient; control comparison uses linear held-out potency only
storage: local tensors/Gram construction/dataset cache. Drive has only cumulative CHECKPOINT.zip + CHECKPOINT_PREVIOUS.zip and tiny identity/lease metadata. Milestones:trained cut,operator completion,model completion; wall-clock checkpoint no more often than15minutes between milestones. Final finished ZIP verified before deleting checkpoints. No per-branch/per-step Drive files
no_claims: architecture effect isolated from dataset effect
new discovery that optimizer memory matters
numerical_rank_cutoff: Eigenvalues below1e-8 times the largest are excluded from inversion/basis construction; their energy remains in trace denominators and the saved spectrum. Actual rank is reported for every requested rank.
